verdicts.reason: A keeps the original centred stack and hierarchy (logo, can, headline, CTA, legal), but the can is undersized, there is a dead gap between can and headline, and the legal line is tiny at the bottom. B blows the can up until it dominates, pushes the headline down against the bottom-left edge, shrinks the CTA to a small pill crammed into the bottom-right corner, and squeezes the legal into an unreadable four-line block under it, so the CTA is buried and the layout feels lopsided.
